description: Pin-bump automation for this project. This file is CONFIGURATION ONLY and is deliberately forge-agnostic: it contains no platform, token, endpoint, onboarding or autodiscover key, because those are self-hosted runner-side options and are not valid in repository config.

Renovate reads this same file unchanged on GitHub, GitLab, Gitea and Forgejo. EXECUTION is the forge-specific half and lives outside this file: run the `renovate` CLI or ghcr.io/renovatebot/renovate on a schedule in whichever forge hosts this repo, supplying RENOVATE_PLATFORM/RENOVATE_TOKEN/RENOVATE_ENDPOINT there. Without such a runner this config is inert but harmless.

helpers:pinGitHubActionDigests keeps the commit-SHA action pins in .github/workflows/ci.yml updated while preserving their version comments; it also applies to .gitea/ and .forgejo/ workflow directories.

The regex manager bumps the tool pins in scripts/ci-install-tools.sh: a `# renovate:` annotation, a `NAME_VERSION` default and, where present, the `NAME_SHA256` default on the next line. Version and digest move in one PR. github-release-attachments resolves the new digest from the vendor's checksum file, or by hashing release assets when there is none; it looks releases up by exact tag, so pins keep the upstream `v`. custom.helm reads the digest from Helm's release notes, because Helm serves its tarballs from get.helm.sh. scripts/check-pinned-urls.sh fails the build if a pin lacks its annotation.

The pip-compile manager reads the `uv pip compile` command from each scripts/ci-requirements/*.txt header, bumps the top-level pin in the matching *.in file and re-locks every transitive dependency with hashes. Its default lockFileMaintenance refreshes transitive versions weekly.
commitBody gives every Renovate commit the Refs: trailer that scripts/ci-check-commit-messages.sh requires; dev-standards-t8u is the standing bead for automated pin updates.

customManagers.description: Tool pins and their SHA-256 digests declared as shell env defaults in the CI installer
